tolerance_rationale: Absolute5s permits small clock slew, timestamp rounding and observer bookkeeping over30–90min campaigns; it rejects the observed15201s discontinuity. This practical receipt-review tolerance is not a CPU-activity, performance or product SLA gate.

timing_coverage_limits.reason: No same-command complete wall pair plus elapsed_seconds; no invented pairing.

limitations: RC per-target and post-gate command receipts lack wall endpoints; their individual clock consistency is not reconstructed. Outer controllers cover these intervals only in aggregate.
The soak wrapper top-level actual_elapsed_seconds covers only the soak command and is never paired with build+soak top-level UTC endpoints.
Matching endpoint clocks cannot rule out short pauses, compensated clock changes, CPU contention, or all system suspension mechanisms; no OS power log was read.
Soak wrapper receipts contain exact source SHA but no tree field; the declared expected tree is not independently recovered in soak-only scope.
This verifier does not rerun tests or replace canonical RC artifact/hash/security or raw-soak acceptance checks.
Observation mode never grants acceptance, including when producer receipts originally say passed. Missing, failed or running final inputs cannot become passed.
